notes.title: Episode 3 + 4 Updates
notes.notes:
Hey guys, today I made a big update for Episode 3 + 4, fixing a lot of mini game issues and making certain dialogue options a lot more consequential, which should really add to the experience. I'm going to be adding a volume slider next  as well as add an additional ending to episode 3 :O, and a couple of other fixes, which hopefully should make the whole experience that much better. 

Stay chillin,
Jason

notes.title: PAX East!! And Updates!!
notes.notes:
Hey, dudes! Jason here! Just wanted to let you know that I'll be updating a bunch of quirky things that are going on in the game by the 9th, just in time for PAX East in Boston! Things like volume controls, quirky QT events, and will also be adding a bit more dialogue to the last couple episodes where it seems to drag a bit.

Also, as I mentioned, I'll be at PAX! If you guys want to come and meet me or the KBros and shoot the shiz, feel free to come by the Playcrafting NYC booth where we'll be showing off this and other really cool games! There's also going to be lots of other indies from NYC showing off their cool stuff. Excited? I sure as heck am.

Anyway, thanks for playing, dudes! And shout out to all the awesome let's players who have been making really funny videos based on the game. It really means a lot :)

Keep on chillin,

Jason
